comparison.objective: Open the clean-ice bin and serve clean ice with a scoop without contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Source discrimination, lid handling, scooping, and delivery.
comparison.success_condition: At least one clean cube delivered without contamination; the record gives no numeric containment or damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: Serving from the correct source is different from breaking retained insert tangs and recovering every fracture product.
